<h2>Description</h2>

<p>Combines the diffusive and ebullitive components of a gas flux into a single
total flux estimate. The total flux is the sum of the two components and the
associated uncertainty is propagated assuming the two errors are independent.
As a consistency check, the reconstructed total flux is compared against a
simple two-point (endpoint) estimate of the total flux over the whole
deployment (<code>F_tot2pts</code>, produced by
<code>goAquaFlux.ebullition</code>). If the reconstructed flux exceeds the
endpoint estimate by more than <code>tolerance</code>, the result is flagged as
potentially suspicious and a warning is issued. This typically indicates that
bubble magnitudes were over-estimated (e.g. a diffusive ramp mistaken for a
step).
</p>


<h2>Usage</h2>

<pre><code class='language-R'>goAquaFlux.total(ebullition_flux, diffusive_flux, tolerance = 1.2)
</code></pre>


<h2>Arguments</h2>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="ebullition_flux">ebullition_flux</code></td>
<td>
<p>A list returned by <code>goAquaFlux.ebullition</code>.
Must contain at least <code>flux</code> (ebullitive flux), <code>SE</code> (its standard
error) and <code>F_tot2pts</code> (the endpoint total-flux estimate).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="diffusive_flux">diffusive_flux</code></td>
<td>
<p>A list returned by <code>goAquaFlux.diffusive</code>.
Must contain at least <code>flux</code> (diffusive flux) and <code>SE</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="tolerance">tolerance</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric &gt; 1. Ratio above which the reconstructed total flux
is flagged as suspiciously larger than the endpoint estimate. Default
<code>1.2</code> (i.e. 20% larger).</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h2>Details</h2>

<p>Total flux:  </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><code class="reqn">F_T = F_E + F_D</code>
</p>

<p>Error propagation (independent errors):  </p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><code class="reqn">SE_T = \sqrt{SE_E^2 + SE_D^2}</code>
</p>



<h2>Value</h2>

<p>A named list with:
</p>

<dl>
<dt>flux</dt><dd><p>Total flux (diffusion + ebullition).</p>
</dd>
<dt>SE</dt><dd><p>Propagated standard error of the total flux.</p>
</dd>
<dt>ratio</dt><dd><p>Ratio of the reconstructed total flux to the two-point
endpoint estimate (<code>NA</code> if the endpoint estimate is unavailable).</p>
</dd>
<dt>flag_suspicious</dt><dd><p>Logical; <code>TRUE</code> when
<code>flux &gt; F_tot2pts * tolerance</code>.</p>
</dd>
<dt>message</dt><dd><p>Diagnostic message (<code>NA</code> when nothing to report).</p>
</dd>
</dl>

<p><code>goAquaFlux.diffusive</code>,
<code>goAquaFlux.ebullition</code>, <code>find.bubbles</code>
</p>
